CatalogUploadForm.description: Browser batch of binary DAT/ZIP uploads; parsing uses bounded multipart chunks.

binding.description:
Absent in pre-CT.2 creation manifests. Deserialization classifies those
archives without rewriting their immutable original metadata.

CollectionBinding.description:
Durable collection ownership. `LegacyUnassigned` is a recovery/read state for
archives created before collection ownership was recorded; typed creation
accepts an assigned module separately and can never request this variant.

CreateCollectionCommand.description:
Typed creation input reserved for CT.2 runtime integration. Keeping the
module mandatory here prevents `LegacyUnassigned` from becoming a valid new
collection request while CT.1 leaves persisted Collection unchanged.

DigitalPurchase.description: Acquisition facts belong to the purchased package, independently of physical copies.

IngestWorkState.description: Current execution only; workflow outcome and preservation are independent.

ItemLifecycle.description: Archive-owned current workflow and capture selection. Historical captures stay addressable.

automatic_grouping_disabled.description: An explicit group undo preserves the user's choice to keep entries apart.

LocalPlaybackDescriptor.description: Authenticated control-plane advertisement; each endpoint has the same server identity.

certificate_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the DER leaf, as required by WebTransport serverCertificateHashes.

oneOf.description: Last accepted automatic decision, distinct from explicit user selection.

Typed domain authority owned by the collection module. Core preserves the
envelope; registry dispatch validates its owner and schema semantics.

preserved_field_overrides.description:
Unrecognized historical field authority, retained verbatim and never applied
as common or domain authority without an explicit owner-aware conversion.

retained_unknown_fields.description: Legacy/provider-specific authority keys remain exact and portable.

complete_identity.description:
A provider's complete identity assertion is ranked before all partial
identifier or layout evidence. It is descriptive identity evidence, not
integrity or catalog verification.

provider_priority.description:
Lower values are preferred. Policy supplies this value; array order never
participates in resolution.

MetadataFieldOverride.description:
Common fields are text, not arbitrary JSON. Artwork has exactly one authority
slot on MetadataAuthority; unknown legacy values remain in its raw envelope.

ModuleData.description:
JSON is the versioned module boundary; known modules parse borrowed/owned views
while the original envelope remains the provenance record.

capture_id.description: Stable representative capture for this disc group; sources retain their actual capture IDs.

sources.description: Source-specific coordinates; empty when no original has been observed.

can_prepare.description: Current actor, module, source and encoder permit explicit preparation.

frame_count.description: Decoded track-local frames; MP3 gapless knowledge is separate in audio_format.

start_frame.description: Coordinate in the source PCM timeline at sample_rate(), with native channels.

sources.description: Source-specific coordinates; empty when no original has been observed.

items.description:
Explicit response shape: unrestricted stored Item records are never
flattened into a transport response.

PresentedAudioCheck.description:
Recorded checks for visible, currently associated originals. This is not an
album-coverage claim: missing discs and unchecked originals remain distinct.

PresentedItem.description:
Explicit response shape: unrestricted stored Item records are never
flattened into a transport response.

oneOf.description: None requests a bounded synthetic reachability probe, never library access.

SaveItemCommand.description:
Editable inventory fields. Revision, timestamps, deletion state, metadata
observations, Evidence, Assets, and Capture representations are server-owned.

SaveItemEditCommand.description:
Item form input whose domain changes are applied by the owning module. The
client can edit declared scalar fields without replacing preserved raw data.

oneOf.description: Recorded current disc identity, for choosing compatible saved responses.
